plans.gaps_summary: Post fleet-expansion the owned fleet now self-performs the plant scope — excavators, water carts, generators, dewatering pumps and the light-vehicle fleet are all covered from spare owned units (no plant hire). Residual HIRE is (1) the workshop (all 3 owned units committed) and (2) the camp accommodation BALANCE — owned modules seed part of the 200-person camp but the bulk of beds is still hired. Much stronger owned-capacity position than the 25-asset fleet, while the large-camp hire remains the headline for a 200-pax shutdown.
